errors.description: The proposed semilinear automorphism does not follow from the conjugacy equation and is not generally in the centralizer of φ. Given φ^σ = f φ f⁻¹ and φ^σ = τσ φ τσ⁻¹, the lift that commutes with φ is f⁻¹ ∘ τσ; the proof instead claims τσ ∘ f⁻¹ does so. This leaves the converse, and thus the stated proof of the exact sequence, invalid as written.
errors.evidence: The proof states: “Since φ^σ = f ∘ φ ∘ f⁻¹, this implies that τσ ∘ f⁻¹ is an element of 𝒩φ mapping to σ.” But (f⁻¹ ∘ τσ) φ (f⁻¹ ∘ τσ)⁻¹ = f⁻¹ φ^σ f = φ, whereas the claimed composition does not generally satisfy this identity.
